title and abstract.summary: The study compared functional group-specific patterns in ground beetles (Carabidae) across three different land-use types: annual cropland, perennial cropland, and semi-natural habitats in Eastern China.

organisms: Metasequoia glyptostroboides Hu and W. C. Cheng
methods.summary: The study sampled beetles and plants across various semi-natural and farmland habitats in Eastern China, documenting the presence of several plant species within these environments. The study measured the body size of individual carabid specimens and surveyed plant species richness and percentage coverage in the study areas.

names: Metasequoia glyptostroboides Hu and W. C. Cheng
